title: KATARU: IoT Malware Adopts Public LPE Exploits
content: KATARU is an IoT malware variant discovered in August 2026 through Telnet credential brute-forcing against a honeypot from Vietnam. title: Malicious Twitch Browser Extension Exposes 30,000 Users' OAuth Tokens to Russian Bot Service
content: A malicious browser extension called 'Twitch Enhanced Viewer | JeetBot' distributed on Chrome Web Store and Firefox Add-ons captures and forwards users' live Twitch OAuth session tokens to Russian-controlled proxy servers. The extension, with approximately 30,000 Chrome users and 552 Firefox users, markets itself as a quality-of-life tool for blocking ads and unlocking streams. While delivering... This pulse includes 27 indicators of compromise (IOCs).

title: New Mirai-Based Linux Botnet 'Evooo1Bot' Turns Victims Into Proxies
content: A sophisticated Linux botnet named Evooo1Bot has been actively targeting internet-facing devices since July 2026, exploiting multiple vulnerabilities in edge devices across diverse regions.
